votes.motion: Commissioner Burggraaf - I move that we approve File 37C20, a non-administrative conditional use permit to operate a crematory/embalming facility at 4306 South Redwood Road, based on Findings in the Staff Report, with the added decision that they have at least 20 parking stalls and approve the hours of operation as proposed. 1:25:30

2:00:10 Commissioner Burggraaf – I move that we approve File #42C20, a Conditional Use Permit Amendment for the Expansion of an “Auto Light Trucks, RV, All-Terrain Vehicle Dealership (Used) – Sales and Service Agency” at 4238 South Redwood Road, based on the Findings as outlined in the Staff Report, with the added condition that all vehicles are parked in designated parking stalls to allow for proper emergency access. This approval also includes all conditions of the original Conditional Use Permit approved in 2012

Commissioner Wendel – I will make a motion. The motion is really not negative for the developers but rather an opportunity to get the best effort possible. I move that we send a negative recommendation to the City Council for a General Plan map amendment for the property located at 4202 South Riverboat Road from “Business Park” to Medium-Density Mixed-Use”, File #2G20, based on Findings in the Staff Report

Commissioner Wendel - I will make a motion. I move that we send a negative recommendation to the City Council for a zoning amendment for the property at 4202 South Riverboat Road from Industrial (ID) to Mixed-Use (MU), File #8Z20, based on the Findings in the Staff Report

Commissioner Berggraaf – 3:15:40 - I move that we send a positive recommendation to the City Council for File #10Z20, regarding the proposed text amendment to the Taylorsville Municipal Code, Sections 13.20.020; R-1 and R-2 Districts Table of Setbacks, Building Heights, Off Street Parking; and Section 13.26.080: Standards for Permanent Signs Allowed Without a Permit. This is based on the Findings in the Staff Report with one amendment being that the flag height be changed from 60 feet to 100 feet in commercial zones. 3:16:47
By motion the meeting was adjourned.
